title: Build time error: Can't resolve @swc/helpers/...

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Verify canary release

- [X] I verified that the issue exists in the latest Next.js canary release

### Provide environment information

```bash
> ./node_modules/.bin/next info

    Operating System:
      Platform: darwin
      Arch: arm64
      Version: Darwin Kernel Version 22.4.0: Mon Mar  6 20:59:28 PST 2023; root:xnu-8796.101.5~3/RELEASE_ARM64_T6000
    Binaries:
      Node: 18.15.0
      npm: 9.6.4
      Yarn: N/A
      pnpm: 8.2.0
    Relevant packages:
      next: 13.3.1-canary.16
      eslint-config-next: 13.3.1-canary.16
      react: 18.2.0
      react-dom: 18.2.0
```


### Which area(s) of Next.js are affected? (leave empty if unsure)

App directory (appDir: true)

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://github.com/jianliao/nextjs-rsp-bug

### To Reproduce

1. Git clone https://github.com/jianliao/nextjs-rsp-bug
2. npm i
3. npm run build

The issue is exactly same as #38192.

### Describe the Bug

After upgrade to `next@13.3.1-canary.16`, next build will fail with below error messages:

https://nextjs.org/docs/messages/module-not-found
